comparisons.note: ABBA uses the mean of two process medians per source. Separation is descriptive, not a significance test. Actual binding ratios use separate single-process measurements.

diagnostics.note: Untimed source-paired JOIN/control comparisons preserve complete values, metadata, costs, errors, consumed prefixes, selected plans and EXPLAIN. Internal cases exercise integer/NULL/text predicates, current bindings, errors and exact cost boundaries; cache proof verifies second use, changed pools, disable controls and eviction. TracePoint counts calls on kernels actually returned by the JOIN helper. These direct file cases cover durable file APIs, but their ordinary query paths do not spill; the focused tests separately exercise the spill seams. Some whole-query budget cases use tiny inputs below the compilation cutoff; actual compiled prefixes are checked by the helper cases and focused immediate-mode tests. Runtime JIT state is recorded; method-specific JIT proof is not claimed. The cache retains only bounded source/pool/kernel data.

cross.note: One fresh process per core; median of five samples. Cross-core checks rendered-value checksums/row counts, not exact costs/metadata. Existing collectors differ; exact binding verification is separate.

profiles.note: execute_prepared with the existing eager collector. All timings precede tracing. Allocations and call counts are diagnostic observations, not sampled CPU-time attribution.
